description: Start a conversation with a candidate by talent slug. Optionally send an initial message. If the conversation already exists, returns it. Use search_talent to find candidates first, then use their slug here. The candidate reads it as coming from the user's company, so show the user the exact text and get their OK before sending. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

message.description: Optional initial message to send with the conversation

talent_slug.description: Talent slug of the candidate to message (from search_talent results)

name: start_conversation
title: Start conversation with candidate
